data.name: Our Last Stand
data.detailed_description:
Our Last Stand is a tower defence set in the future where humans are having to jump planet to planet just to survive. You must gather resources, hold back the enemy waves and leave when the going gets tough as you only get one chance so it is your last stand. 

Play on different worlds to gather resources, unlock advanced technology, and level your commander to gain powerful new abilities. Build, defend, survive.

Starting:

On every map you must choose a starting location for your main ship. lose this ship and its game over so defending it is very important. Gather resources to build defences, unlock new buildings with rare crystals, choose your commander mech that stays with you until you die each commander has a different playstyle. Survive until the victory condition is met to gain a small amount of resources and allow your self to progress.

Commander:

Choose a commander mech to help you on the field. A selectable commander unit that can be levelled up to gain more health and damage, but also gains new abilities depending on its level. These commander units are very important towards your survival.

Build:

A strong economy allows a player to construct different types of defences from turrets to shields, but remember these cost power to run and no power means nothing will work so try not to get caught out over buying defences. The more buildings you have means more food is required for the people to maintain them, without food everything will start to fall apart literally.

Technology:

Gather crystals to research new technology, the tech tree is vital for surviving harder levels in the game so make sure to grab them before trying harder difficulties. 

Trade:

You may be joined online by another player. Unlock the trade ability to enable trading between players, it could be the difference between victory or defeat.

Co-op:

Play with another friend and take on the waves of enemies together, or just find somebody who may just need a little help.

Discord: 

join our Discord to find players, chat and discuss ideas for the future of the game.

About me:

Hi, just a solo developer having some fun creating content, I hope you enjoy the game and I will be updating the game with new content and bug fixes, so if you find an issue please let me know, or even if you have a good idea that you would like added into the game id like to hear your suggestions and maybe ill add them in.

Play on different worlds to gather resources, unlock advanced technology, and level your commander to gain powerful new abilities. Build defend, survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 650 or AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Low settings, 720p resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: High settings, 1080p smooth gameplay
